title: ProtocolMetric
description: One protocol-level metric at one point in time (TVL, DEX volume, fees, revenue, market share, active users, rank). data.metric ALREADY STORES THE SHAPE - (series_id, at, value, meta) with source defaulting to 'derived' - and data.tvl_protocol / data.tvl_chain store the TVL case specifically, so this schema names the contract those rows must satisfy rather than inventing storage. The metric is an ENUM, not a free-form label, because 'volume' reported in USD and 'volume' reported in native units are different facts and a free-form string lets them collide. plan §22: DefiLlama is the baseline protocol analytics source and the others enrich or validate it.

$ref.description: Null means the metric is protocol-aggregated across chains, matching data.tvl_protocol's chain_id = '' convention.

metric.description: The metric name. Closed set: a metric that is not listed here is not a ProtocolMetric and must not be squeezed into one.

value.description: Exact decimal string. A USD metric is in USD; market_share_pct is 0-100; rank and counts are integers carried as decimal strings so one field type serves every metric.

window.description: The aggregation window the value covers ('24h', '7d', '30d', 'all'). Null when the metric is instantaneous (TVL) or when the provider does not state one - null is not '24h'.
